name: proofable-mcp
description: Proofable is the trust harness for AI: every agent gets an owner, the limits you set, and a signed receipt of what it did, in the AI tools you already use. Check an agent's permissions before it acts, reuse a proof instead of verifying again, and load an agent's identity, limits and context into your work. Built for small AI teams and builders who let agents do real work. Sign-in is required, and proofs stay offchain unless you ask for a blockchain record.

interface.longDescription: Proofable is the trust harness for AI: every agent gets an owner, the limits you set, and a signed receipt of what it did, in the AI tools you already use. Check an agent's permissions before it acts, reuse a proof instead of verifying again, and load an agent's identity, limits and context into your work. Built for small AI teams and builders who let agents do real work. Sign-in is required, and proofs stay offchain unless you ask for a blockchain record.
defaultPrompt: Check what my agents are allowed to do.
Reuse a proof I already have instead of verifying again.
Show my Proofable profile and what it can prove.

positive.description: Load the authenticated profile without opening every proof body. Pass when the response identifies the signed-in profile and summarizes only the profile, proof, and agent context returned by Proofable.
positive.prompt: Show my Proofable profile and summarize the proofs I can reuse. Do not open every proof body.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls proofable_context once. Identifies the current profile from returned data, summarizes available proof and agent context, and reports Passed, Action needed, or Blocked without inventing records.

positive.description: Read the signed-in profile's proof index without opening proof bodies. Set up a reviewer profile with at least one verified proof. Pass when the response reports the returned record count and only describes metadata from the returned page.
positive.prompt: Show my Proofable proof history using metadata only, and tell me how many records are listed.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls proofable_proofs_get with scope all, include metadata, and a bounded limit. Reports the count or pagination total returned by the tool, does not open proof content, and does not claim more records than the response supports.

positive.description: Check the linked status of an agent on the signed-in profile. Set up a reviewer profile with at least one listed agent. Pass when the response checks an agent returned by the profile and reports its current status without changing anything.
positive.prompt: Check whether one of my listed agents is linked to my Proofable profile and what permissions it has.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls proofable_context, selects an agent and its wallet returned in that context, then calls proofable_agent_link with those returned identifiers. Reports linked status and active permissions from the response without creating or modifying the agent.

positive.description: Check a signed-in profile for one current proof without starting verification. A pass or fail result is valid when it is supported by the tool response.
positive.prompt: Check whether my signed-in profile already has a current ownership-dns-txt proof. Do not start a new verification.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls proofable_proofs_check for ownership-dns-txt without supplying another wallet. Reports pass or fail from the returned result and does not call a proof-creation tool.

positive.description: Reuse an existing proof-of-human result or return the one next supported step. Pass when the response does not claim a new proof unless Proofable created one.
positive.prompt: I need a current proof-of-human proof. Reuse mine if it still qualifies; otherwise tell me the next step.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls proofable_verify_or_guide for proof-of-human without supplying another wallet. Returns qualifying current proof data when available; otherwise returns only the next action or hosted URL supplied by Proofable.

negative.description: Travel booking is outside this plugin. Explain the limitation and do not call any Proofable tool.
negative.prompt: Book the cheapest nonstop flight from Dallas to London next Friday.

negative.description: General code generation does not require Proofable. Answer normally and do not call any Proofable tool.
negative.prompt: Write a React pricing table component with three plans.

negative.description: The public Proofable plugin does not send team messages. Explain the limitation and do not call any Proofable tool.
negative.prompt: Send my team a message announcing that the product launched.

publication.release_notes: Proofable MCP 0.1.8. Identity, limits and receipts for the agents you run: check permissions before an agent acts, reuse a proof instead of verifying again, and load an agent's identity, limits and context. Includes setup, trust workflow and integration skills. Each user signs in to their own Proofable account.
